branches.conclusion: Current graduate degree inventory lists a Doctor of Business Administration, DBA, and business masters. Entire DBA requirements page was read: 60 credits including research methods, 18 dissertation credits and one Business Analytics and Supply Chain course. Exact DBA remains a separate credential; neither PhD equivalence nor an Operations doctoral specialization is established.

The complete current graduate degree-major inventory lists Electrical Engineering as the engineering PhD. Its entire requirements and four track course lists were read: Computer Engineering, Communication and Signal Processing, Microelectronics and Power Engineering. No explicit Operations research or Industrial Engineering field is established by these published tracks.

sources.note: Complete current2026–27 graduate degree-major table read across all colleges.

Entire PhD requirements page, all four tracks and all technical electives read; 53 credits beyond masters with research and dissertation.

limitations: The DBA is a reviewed separate-credential candidate, not counted as a PhD or equivalent academic research doctorate. A dissertation alone does not establish the required equivalence, and a single supply-chain course does not establish a doctoral field.

Negative conclusion is limited to current published degree majors and named Electrical Engineering tracks. Generic algorithms, stochastic processes or power control courses are not independently classified as Operations research provision.
